scope: Measured whole-horse anatomical rest chain and real world-translated RiderView at 30/60/120Hz, both facings, four steady gaits and actual-model hold/release. Checks finite bone lengths, anatomical IK branches, near-straight load-bearing fore wrist, hoof grounding/lock and transition bounds, support/flight and new-round cache reset. No render captures or OS input generated by this script; passing geometry is not human approval of silhouette, skin seams or natural movement.
